messages:
Aisha: Quick sync — AcmeHealth asked for per-route cost heatmaps + trace hook guidance. Thinking a 6-week initiative: dashboards + sampling defaults + error buckets. Who's in for scoping?
Cam: +1 from infra. We need to clarify data retention and rollup granularity. Per-route raw token logs blow up fast.
Jordan: Important to capture 95th token latency by model and route. Heatmaps should let customers filter by model, region, and customer tier.
Len: For tracing hooks: we can emit a small span for each request with tags: model, route, tokens, batch_size. Sampling default 1% with heads-up on cold starts.
Maria: From customer success — AcmeHealth cares about cost attribution to features (not just routes). They want a CSV export for month-end.
Aisha: Good note. Proposal: MVP scope = (1) per-route cost heatmap UI + CSV export, (2) tracing hook with default tags + sampling config UI, (3) error analytics grouped by error class + example query. Can we define launch criteria?
Cam: Ops constraints: must not add >5% additional ingestion cost. If tracing hook increases egress/ingest beyond threshold, fallback to aggregated counters.
Jordan: Suggested launch acceptance: latency regression <2% p95, cost delta vs baseline <5% for high-throughput customers, CSV export available for 30-day window.
Len: Technical checklist snippet:
```
- emit_span(model, route, tokens, batch)
- default_sampling = 0.01
- fallback: aggregate_counts(route, model) if ingest_rate>X
```
Aisha: UX asks: single heatmap with model on Y, route on X, color = cost per 1k tokens. Click -> open trace samples (if sampled).
Maria: Also add an "impact" column in CSV: estimated monthly delta if switching to smaller model for that route. Customers love quick recommendations.
Cam: We should surface recommended autoscale/burst settings per-route in the console later, but not in MVP.
Jordan: Ops: how about rollout plan — canary to 10% of accounts (non-enterprise) then ramp to 100% after 2 weeks if no alerts.
Aisha: Timeline idea: Week 1 specs + infra changes, Week 2 tracing hook + sampling controls, Week 3 UI for heatmap + CSV, Week 4 QA + canary, Week 5 ramp + feedback, Week 6 polish + enterprise docs.
Len: Question: where do quantization/quant model variants show up? We should surface model variant breakdown in heatmap (gpt-q4_0 -> small cost).
Maria: Customer ask: enterprise customers need export to S3 and masking for PII. Add privacy gating to enterprise-only flag.
Cam: Ok — gating: tracing span payload must be scrubbed by default; enterprise can enable richer spans with KMS-protected storage.
Aisha: Acceptance criteria (final draft):
- functional: heatmap UI, CSV export, trace span emission with sampling toggle
- reliability: p95 latency regression <2% and no increased error rate in canary window
- cost: ingest/calc overhead <5% for typical workloads; fallback to aggregated counters if exceeded
- security: default PII scrubbing; enterprise S3 export behind ACLs/KMS
Jordan: I'll add telemetry hooks so we can monitor feature adoption + cost delta. AlertBot: new canary deployed to 10% cohort at 5187654380 :rocket:
Maria: Thanks — I'll sync with AcmeHealth on acceptance criteria and sample dataset.
Aisha: Great. Next step: Jordan + Len to draft infra spec by EOD tomorrow, Cam to estimate ingestion cost delta, Maria to confirm export/PII needs with two customers. Follow-up in #product next Tuesday. :calendar:
